content:
Pink step should say "on the RIGHT side".

I stuck the 3mm allen wrench in one of the other holes on the puck holder bottom and into the side panel while tightening the screws to ensure the holes would align in the next steps.

I’m going to leave my tip here as good as place as any: before you start mounting all these puck holders with the nylon nuts, i would have preferred to somehow install the tool heads and then power on the printer and try the self tests. Something is messed with my X Y axis and I have to take all these nuts off just to get the side panels off again.
